stories.title: Maltempo su Roma, linea temporalesca in arrivo sulla città: immagini dal drone

en.title: Bad weather over Rome, storm line approaching the city: drone footage
en.summary: A storm system is moving toward Rome. Drone images capture the approaching weather front.

stories.title: La Lincoln tornata a casa. Trump: "Niente attacchi prima del voto". Yemen, l'escalation.

en.title: The Lincoln returned home. Trump: "No attacks before the vote". Yemen, the escalation.
en.summary: Marines were welcomed in San Diego following the USS Lincoln's return. Regional tensions involve missile interceptions by Saudi Arabia, Italian military deployment, and Israeli diplomatic actions.

stories.title: L’Ue frena Italia e Grecia: “No a nuova flessibilità”. Giorgetti: siamo fiduciosi

en.title: EU brakes Italy and Greece: "No new flexibility". Giorgetti: we are confident
en.summary: The European Commission and northern EU countries rejected an Italian and Greek proposal for budgetary flexibility to address inflation costs. Italy remains optimistic about negotiations.

stories.title: Roma, cinque bersagli della banda in minicar: c’è un primo identikit. Ancora grave Davide Iacopini

en.title: Rome, five targets of the minivan gang: first profile emerges. Davide Iacopini still in serious condition
en.summary: Police have developed an initial profile of a gang using a car with obscured license plates to attack cyclists and scooter riders in Rome. An actor victim underwent surgery and remains in serious condition.

stories.title: Hegseth: “La fucilazione dell'autore della strage di Fort Hood pubblica”. Sarà in streaming

en.title: Hegseth: "Fort Hood shooting perpetrator's execution to be public". It will be streamed
en.summary: Nidal Malik Hasan, convicted of a mass shooting, is scheduled for execution by firing squad on December 3rd and the event will be broadcast as a livestream.

stories.title: Ore 14 sera, parla per la prima volta il figlio di Bossetti: "Mio padre non è un assassino"

en.title: At 2pm, Bossetti's son speaks for the first time: "My father is not a murderer"
en.summary: The son of a convicted prisoner claims his father was denied investigative review procedures granted to other condemned inmates and has been abandoned by the system.

stories.title: Usa, la fucilazione dell'autore della strage di Fort Hood sarà trasmessa in diretta streaming

en.title: USA, Fort Hood shooting perpetrator's execution to be broadcast live via streaming
en.summary: Nidal Hasan, sentenced for killing 13 people in a 2009 military base shooting, will be executed by firing squad on December 3rd. Separately, lawyers report on a survivor of failed lethal injections in Tennessee.

stories.title: 'La fucilazione dell'autore della strage di Fort Hood sarà in diretta streaming'

en.title: The execution of Fort Hood massacre perpetrator will be livestreamed
en.summary: A Pentagon official confirmed that the execution will be broadcast online, according to American media reports.

stories.title: Venti minuti per individuare una vittima. La banda della minicar e l’ipotesi sfida social

en.title: Twenty minutes to identify a victim. The minicar gang and the social media challenge hypothesis
en.summary: An actor is reported in serious condition following an assault in Rome, with investigators examining at least five similar incidents and considering a social media challenge connection.

stories.title: Flessibilità, Dombrovskis: "Parlato con Giorgetti, esamineremo le richieste dell'Italia"

en.title: Flexibility, Dombrovskis: "Spoke with Giorgetti, we will examine Italy's requests"
en.summary: The European economy commissioner stated he would examine Italy's proposals on fiscal flexibility. The Italian finance minister reported broad support for Italy's flexibility proposal at the Eurogroup meeting.

stories.title: Anzio, il maltempo fa crollare la parete di roccia sulla spiaggia: le immagini dal drone

en.title: Anzio, bad weather causes rock wall to collapse on beach: drone images
en.summary: A section of coastal cliff collapsed onto a beach near Rome following severe weather. The affected area, known for ongoing erosion issues, is part of a stretch of Lazio coast struggling with stability problems.

stories.title: Yara Gambirasio, parla per la prima volta il figlio di Massimo Bossetti: «A mio padre non è stato concesso il diritto di difendersi»

en.title: Yara Gambirasio, Massimo Bossetti's son speaks for the first time: "My father was not granted the right to defend himself"
en.summary: The son of Massimo Bossetti spoke publicly regarding his father's case. The interview will air on Rai Due this evening.

stories.title: Milano Home, si rafforza il retail specializzato

en.title: Milano Home, specialized retail strengthens
en.summary: The Milano Home trade fair for specialized and independent retailers of home goods, textiles, and gifts will return from January 21-24, 2027.

stories.title: Brand globali dall’anima locale, la nuova partita si gioca sotto casa

en.title: Global brands with local soul, the new competition plays out in your backyard
en.summary: International brands are increasingly competing in local markets through localized strategies. The comparison suggests this competitive dynamic resembles regional rivalries, with examples from major cities worldwide.

stories.title: Aerospazio, dal business satellitare spinta ai progetti hi tech

en.title: Aerospace, satellite business drives high-tech projects
en.summary: Italy's aerospace sector needs to strengthen its competitive position in Europe and globally through coordinated effort between companies and institutions, according to Sitael's CEO Chiara Pertosa.

stories.title: Energy Dome, la batteria alla CO2 fatta a Piacenza

en.title: Energy Dome, the CO2 battery made in Piacenza
en.summary: Energy Dome has officially opened a manufacturing facility in Piacenza producing large domes containing compressed CO2 as part of its proprietary energy storage system called CO2 Battery.

stories.title: Intesa Sanpaolo stanzia 20 miliardi per le piccole imprese

en.title: Intesa Sanpaolo allocates 20 billion for small businesses
en.summary: Intesa Sanpaolo has announced a 20 billion euro initiative through its Territorial Banking Division to support small and medium-sized enterprises in the tertiary sector.
